```{r}
#install.packages('here')
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

#folder <- "C:/Code Projects/Code Blue Training Year 2/Data/"

# changed this to a relative path
survey_responses <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "arcbt.xlsx"))

survey_responses <- survey_responses %>%
  mutate(
    change_con_code = post_con_code - pre_con_code,
    change_con_rapid = post_con_rapid - pre_con_rapid, 
    change_con_rhythm = post_con_rhythm - pre_con_rhythm,
    change_attending = post_attending - pre_attending,
    change_team = post_team - pre_team
  )

summary(survey_responses)

```

Pre

```{r}
library(modelsummary)

# Define custom functions for the 25th and 75th percentiles
q1 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
n_non_missing <- function(x) sum(!is.na(x))

# Create the summary table with median, Q1, Q3, and N
datasummary((N = n_non_missing) +
            (Median) + 
            (Q1 = q1) + 
            (Q3 = q3) ~ 
              pre_con_code + pre_con_rapid + pre_con_rhythm + pre_team + pre_attending + pre_lead + pre_codes + pre_rapid + pre_shock + pre_sim, 
            data = survey_responses)
```

Regressions (added by BL)

```{r}
#### —— setup (quiet) ———————————————————————————
# in your Quarto/Rmd chunk header also set: {r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(broom)
  library(lmtest); library(sandwich); library(glue)
})

# read without messages; then fix the first unnamed column
dat <- suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(here::here("data","arcbt.xlsx")))
if (identical(names(dat)[1], "...1")) names(dat)[1] <- "id"

# coerce only what we need (defensive)
dat <- dat %>%
  transmute(
    id              = as.character(id),
    pre_con_rapid   = as.numeric(pre_con_rapid),
    pre_con_code    = as.numeric(pre_con_code),
    pre_rapid       = as.numeric(pre_rapid),
    pre_sim         = as.numeric(pre_sim),
    pre_codes       = as.numeric(pre_codes)
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(pre_con_rapid, pre_con_code, pre_rapid, pre_sim, pre_codes))

#### —— helper: HC3 CI extractor ——————————————————
hc3_ci <- function(fit) {
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3")
  tt <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = V)
  est <- coef(fit)
  se  <- sqrt(diag(V))
  tibble::tibble(
    term     = names(est),
    estimate = as.numeric(est),
    conf.low = as.numeric(est + qnorm(0.025) * se),
    conf.high= as.numeric(est + qnorm(0.975) * se)
  ) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)")
}

#### —— the 3 per-1-unit regressions ————————————
m1 <- lm(pre_con_rapid ~ pre_rapid, data = dat)   # per 1 rapid → rapid confidence
m2 <- lm(pre_con_code  ~ pre_sim,   data = dat)   # per 1 sim   → code confidence
m3 <- lm(pre_con_code  ~ pre_codes, data = dat)   # per 1 code  → code confidence

out <- bind_rows(
  hc3_ci(m1) %>% mutate(outcome = "Rapid confidence", exposure = "per 1 rapid"),
  hc3_ci(m2) %>% mutate(outcome = "Code confidence",  exposure = "per 1 simulation"),
  hc3_ci(m3) %>% mutate(outcome = "Code confidence",  exposure = "per 1 code")
) %>%
  transmute(
    outcome, exposure,
    slope = estimate,
    ci    = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", conf.low, conf.high)
  )

# print a minimal table for the abstract
out
```
